name: Side-by-side figures (subcaption)
description: Two images next to each other, each with its own (a)/(b) caption, plus a shared caption.
notes: `example-image-a` / `-b` come with the `mwe` package. Replace them with your own file names (no extension needed).
Keep the widths summing to just under 1 (`0.48 + 0.48`) and put `\hfill` between them.
`[b]` aligns the subfigures on their bottom edge, which matters when the images have different heights.
